topic_title: Chapter 4 - Lesson 4-1 - Types and Characteristics of Media

questions.question: A website can present text, images, and video in combination.
TV is a two-way medium that allows users to respond and share.
SNS is highly effective at spreading information rapidly.
What type of medium allows users to respond and share information?
For each situation, choose the most suitable medium: A TV, B Website, C SNS, D Email.

items.text: Provide detailed product information that can be viewed at any time.
Spread information by word of mouth.
Deliver a video to many people at once.
Send campaign information directly to existing customers.

questions.question: Which is NOT an appropriate characteristic of a website?
options: Information can be updated at any time.
Information automatically reaches users without active access.
Text, images, and video can be combined.
Forms and comments can allow two-way interaction.

questions.question: Which medium is most suitable for spreading information through users voluntarily sharing it?
Explain why an organization might use a website, TV, and SNS together rather than using only one medium.
questions.model_answer: TV can reach many people at once, a website can provide detailed information that is available at any time, and SNS can help users share and spread the information by word of mouth.

questions.question: A hospital wants to announce new opening hours to many people and also allow patients to ask questions. Recommend suitable media and explain your choices.
questions.model_answer: TV or SNS can be used for rapid reach, while a website with forms or comments, or SNS, can provide two-way interaction so patients can ask questions.
